description: Everything that happened after a cursor, oldest first: new signals, and on Pro closed signals (with the result) and pause/resume of short signals. Returns at once. Use it to catch up after being offline, then switch to wait_for_signal. Without "after" it returns only the current cursor.

after.description: Cursor to read from. Use 0 for the oldest events your plan keeps.

apiKey.description: API key — omit if your client was installed with it (X-Api-Key header or ?apiKey=).

minConfidence.description: Only signals at or above this confidence (1–100). Pro.

name: get_events
title: Get Events Since A Cursor
